display_index.label: Display port
display_index.description: 0 = all ports (recommended). Otherwise the nvibrant port number, 1 = first.

no_ctm.title: NVibrant: niri has no color-matrix
no_ctm.body: Saturation on non-NVIDIA outputs needs a niri build with the `output color-matrix` action. See the plugin README (Requirements).

failed.title: NVibrant failed
failed.body: nvibrant returned an error. Check the display port in plugin settings.
